checked_profile.summary: Small installment loans with lender, state and vehicle-collateral differences.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Who lends?
facts.text: Oportun originates loans in New Mexico and Wisconsin. In other listed operating states, Pathward or Column originates loans arranged through Oportun.

facts.label: Unsecured amounts
facts.text: Column lists $500–$6,000; Pathward lists $300–$10,000, with amounts above $6,000 unavailable to first-time borrowers. State minimums apply.

facts.label: Secured borrowing
facts.text: Pathward vehicle-secured loans of $2,525–$18,500 are limited to listed states and qualifying vehicles. The collateral must satisfy ownership, value and insurance rules.

facts.label: Fees and credit review
facts.text: An administrative fee of up to 10% can reduce proceeds. A prior credit history is not required, but credit reports are requested and considered. Prequalification differs from the final application. A nationwide APR range was not established from this page.
